newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume eases further.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume eases further.

text.p: Gold prices ended mixed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Wednesday with falls reflecting a firm Turkish lira while volume dropped further, dealers said.
Gold closed $1.25 higher at $383.75 an ounce, following the European trends.
But it edged lower to 1,119,400 lira per gram from Tuesday's 1,119,900 lira as the lira closed firmer at 90,720 per dollar after yesterday's 90,820.
Traded volume was 364 kilos, down from 416 on Tuesday and 1,690 on Monday.

"It was another quiet day. The market chose to wait as gold was stuck in the 382-383.55 range abroad. Firmer lira produced drops in gold prices in lira terms and caused sellers to sideline," said one dealer.
"I expect activity to remain quiet because free market demand has narrowed with the ending of the summer season," he added.
Afternoon volume was 130 kilos after 234 in the first session, 65.7 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms.
